messages:
From: Alison Hart <alison.hart@novamed.com>

Subject: Novamed RFP — commercial clarification on staged commits and spot billing

Irene / Redwood team,

Thanks for your RFP submission. We have a couple of follow-ups specific to Section 3 (commercials) before we schedule a final pricing review. Please see short questions below — if you can answer directly or point us to the specific appendix workbook that contains the math, that would help.

1) Staged commit definition: your RFP response mentions a "staged commit" option where NovaMed can tranche an annual commit into quarterly tranches with a 10% premium. Can you confirm how unused tokens in an early tranche are handled if we later increase the next tranche? Is there an automatic true-up or explicit top-up?

2) Spot billing / overage path: For consumption above committed volume, you list a spot rate and a capped overage. Are spot charges billed at a per-token list rate or a sliding discount when sustained? How do you apply burst credits (if any) before spot billing?

3) Graceband and roll-forward: Do you support a 30-day graceband (carry across months) or only annual true-ups? If roll-forward is allowed, are discounts preserved?

4) Auditability: We need invoice line-items that map to RFP line items and a CSV export of monthly token usage per model and per route. Does the Dedicated/Private offering have the same invoicing detail as Hosted?

We would appreciate a short consolidated response and any XLS tabs that show the sample calculations (we referenced your Appendix v2 but need final numbers).

Regards,
Alison Hart
Procurement Lead — NovaMed

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Novamed RFP — commercial clarification on staged commits and spot billing

Alison — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; we'll attach a concise commercial appendix and an example worksheet (see attachments) with the line-by-line math.

1) Staged commits: unused tokens in an earlier tranche are available to carry forward within the same contract year. If you increase a subsequent tranche, we apply an automatic pro-rata true-up to the next invoice to reflect the higher commit; no retroactive refund for prior tranches. You can also request a manual top-up instead of automatic billing if you want to manage spend more tightly.

2) Spot billing / overages: spot charges default to the published per-token list rate for the model variant used. Sustained overage discounts are supported: we apply a sliding discount based on rolling 30-day sustained overage bands (documented in the appendix). Burst credits (one-time annual cushion) are consumed prior to spot billing; after credits are exhausted, spot rates apply.

3) Graceband and roll-forward: we support a 30-day graceband for smoothing between months inside the same quarter; annual true-up still applies. Roll-forward to the next contract year is possible for up to 12% of committed volume (subject to product/price review) and discounts are preserved at the committed tier for rolled-forward volume.

4) Auditability: yes — Hosted, Dedicated, and Private have consistent invoice schemas. For Private deployed in a VPC you can opt-in for local export of monthly CSVs; for Hosted we provide the CSV from our billing exports. The appendix includes the schema of the CSV (model id, route id, token_in, token_out, timestamp, cost_center).

I'm looping in Karthik (pricing math) and Marissa (commercial terms) to confirm the exact numbers and attach the workbook. Expect a follow-up within 2 hours.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Irene / Marissa — attached is the proposed commercial appendix and the NovaMed_Scenarios tab (I've copied the key lines below). Please review and confirm before I send to Alison.

Key pricing points (summary):
- Committed tiers (annual): 100M tokens = $0.0009/token; 250M tokens = $0.00075/token; 500M tokens = $0.00065/token.
- Staged commit premium: 10% uplift applied to the per-token committed price for any tranche that is delivered as a quarterly tranche instead of an upfront annual commit. E.g., 100M staged quarterly -> per-token committed price becomes $0.00099 for tranches.
- Unused tokens: carry-forward inside contract year; pro-rata true-up on the next invoice if tranche size increased.
- Burst cushion: 500k tokens annual credit consumed first; thereafter spot billing applies at list rate with sustained discount.
- Sustained overage ladder (post-burst credits): 0-10% over commit -> 0% extra discount (list spot rate), 10-50% sustained over 30d -> 10% off spot, >50% -> 20% off spot (applied to overage volume only).
- Spot rate examples (for the models in your RFP): base spot = $0.0012/token for large LLM variant; discounts applied per ladder above.

Invoice mapping: each invoice line will include: period_start, period_end, model_id, route, committed_tokens_consumed, overage_tokens, burst_credit_used, unit_price, line_total. CSV export format included in appendix.

I've attached: Redwood_Pricing_Appendix_v3.pdf and Novamed_RFP_Section-3_Commercial.xlsx (tab: NovaMed_Scenarios, InvoiceLines). If that's good, I'll send to Alison.

—Karthik
